title: Descending auction
description: Composition marker: this order's counterparty is selected by an on-network descending-price (Dutch) auction. The clause carries no committed content — its semantics live entirely in block.composes (the standard descending-auction interface the order composes with) and block.fields (the runtime startPrice the buyer supplies at checkout). The auction executes on the composed contract (createAuction / claim); its state is read from that contract's own events, not from AttestationCoordinator. Agreement-only, like figaro-topology: committed at agreement signing, never re-asserted as a runtime attestation.

fields.name: startPrice
fields.description: Opening (maximum) price the descending auction starts from; the price decays until a provider claims the order.
